entry_correction: 0x013fca18 is an interior no-number MOV branch of 0x013fc904, not a function entry.

canonical_provider.media: The provider reads FAT12/FAT16/FAT32/exFAT entries through the actual owned filesystem_runtime::SectorIo. The remote catalog does not enumerate a host directory or accept a catalog-summary callback.

owned_api.storage: Caller-owned object and per-directory scratch slices. Directory collision names and file-number slot indexes are bounded scan-local arrays. No allocation or full-record sorting.
owned_api.publication: One-based typed object handles retain actual typed paths, sizes, protection and timestamps. Numeric unique entries precede image overflow then MOV overflow. Primary order is ascending; mode3 numeric order is descending. Mode3 does not enumerate RAF.
owned_api.streaming: CatalogGeneration invalidates previously captured object-list snapshots on scan, insert, successful removal, cancellation or teardown.
owned_api.failure: Filesystem errors remain typed and device statuses remain available. Completed publications remain visible on later failure. Scan leases are closed on completion or cancelled on enumeration failure. Media cancellation publishes Cancelled, not success. Teardown removes visibility and scratch ownership.
owned_api.redesign: The canonical provider exposes synchronous exclusive scan leases. Stock callback continuations are expressed as direct owned control flow. Queue completion and installed interface-table state belong to InterfaceModes, not this module.

tests.provenance: Synthetic FAT16 sectors assembled in memory and consumed by the production sector-backed catalog parser. The fault-only SectorIo test injects the public Cancelled error.
